analysis.summary: The PR renames price fields and updates discount display logic, but introduces inconsistent fallback behavior and a logic error using falsy checks for numeric percentage values.

bugs.title: Inconsistent fallback and incorrect falsy check in pricing logic
bugs.description: The logic for discountPercentage and discountAmount introduces a fallback to Gross values (discount) when Net values (netDiscount) are missing. This is inconsistent with the cashPrice calculation (lines 192-194), which correctly displays a placeholder (-) if Net data is missing. Furthermore, using '||' for totalDiscountPercentage causes a valid 0% net discount to be incorrectly overridden by a Gross discount value.
bugs.risk: This causes a mismatched UI where the main price value is missing/placeholder while a discount badge (from gross data) is still displayed. It also leads to mathematically incorrect pricing displays when net and gross discounts differ or when one is zero.
bugs.codeSnippet:
discountPercentage={
                    showVat
                      ? product?.promoBadgePrice?.discount
                          ?.totalDiscountPercentage
-                      : product?.promoBadgePrice?.notDiscount
-                          ?.totalDiscountPercentage
+                      : product?.promoBadgePrice?.netDiscount
+                          ?.totalDiscountPercentage ||
+                        product?.promoBadgePrice?.discount
+                          ?.totalDiscountPercentage
                   }

notBugs.reason: Excluding discounts in the DEMO sales channel is a deliberate business logic change for this feature.
While the string replacement logic in price.tsx for truncated labels is brittle (may fail if placeholders are middle-aligned), it does not cause runtime crashes or affect core functional behavior.

notBugs.reason: The rename is consistent across the BFF types and the updated consumer in the pricing-info component.
